name: Mahjong Shoujo Mami ★ Madoka
source:
The magical girls face a demonic foe with fresh tricks.
Mami gives Madoka a mahjong lesson and some physical training.
What sort of beast is she up against...? What will be Madoka's fate!?

[From DLsite English]
translation:
魔法少女们迎战花招百出的魔物强敌。
麻美为小圆展开了一场麻将特训与贴身肉体指导。
她们面对的究竟是怎样的凶兽……？小圆的命运又将如何！？

[摘自DLsite英文版]
